model: Feature branches ship through /ship at a validation tier proportional to risk: tier 0 none (editing branches), tier 1 repo checks plus one independent-model review (default), tier 2 three review legs (risky or wide diffs), tier 3 the opt-in no-mistakes gate. Review ceremony is negotiable and an agent may decline a leg with a stated reason; the git-level main pre-push hook and bash-safety-guard.sh are NOT negotiable and block unconfigured protected-branch and bare/ambiguous pushes. push-gate (durable leases, semantic-scope approval, Dolt stack trunks) was retired; do not reintroduce its fields.

review_tiers.purpose: Match validation ceremony to risk. A check that fires on every change regardless of stakes gets routed around, so escalate on risk rather than habit.

tier_0_none.when: Editing branches and throwaway spikes; review is a delivery concern, not an editing concern.
tier_0_none.note: Yolo branches review the end state once - before promotion, before handoff, or on request - never continuously.

tier_1_self_review.when: Default for an ordinary feature/fix branch headed for a PR.

tier_2_multi_model.when: Diff touches security guards, hooks, auth, credentials, crypto, or push/delivery policy; can lose data or is hard to reverse; is wide (>400 changed lines or >15 files); or changes behaviour the user cannot easily re-verify.
tier_2_multi_model.note: Cursor legs run sequentially; ~/.cursor/cli-config.json is user-level state that concurrent runs race on.

tier_3_no_mistakes.when: Only on an explicit user ask, or where a repository's own policy requires it. Requires no-mistakes init.
tier_3_no_mistakes.note: Not a precondition for pushing. Good for a large or unfamiliar change you want babysat end to end; wrong as a default because its cost does not scale down.

review_tiers.declining: Stating 'skipping review: <reason>' in one line is a sanctioned outcome. Skipping silently, or claiming a review that did not run, is not.
review_tiers.sizing: Target under ~400 changed lines and ~15 files per PR, one reviewable claim each, refactors separate from behaviour changes. Split rather than escalate where possible.

delivery_feature_branches.purpose: Default delivery path: a feature branch validated at the warranted review tier, then pushed to the configured target, opening/updating a PR. Drive it via the /ship skill.

gnhf_branches.purpose: gnhf long-run loops create and push their own working branch. Review the end state before promoting to a delivery branch. Bounded runs use --max-iterations / --max-tokens.

scratch_branches.purpose: Opt-in remote backup, resumability, and cross-workspace handoff outside PR delivery.

yolo_branches.purpose: Reserved for an explicitly configured private policy overlay; disabled in the portable public baseline.

delivery_branches.notes: Any branch with an open PR, intended PR, or PR-base relationship is delivery scope and is reviewed at its warranted tier unless a repo-specific direct-push exception applies.
